verdict.rationale: treg's catalog endpoint `/catalog/platforms/{slug}` lists providers side by side with measured success rate, speed and price, which is a direct comparison on published quality signals. Per-call usefulness reviews feed additional quality data, and every endpoint carries its price and an example response. missing for 10: no usage counts or verification badges evidenced, no detail on how success-rate/speed are measured or how often refreshed, no liveness/uptime checks for providers (`treg health` covers only team credentials), no independent or hands-on corroboration.
